note: Knob DIFF over the base puzzle-text (tx5 paired contained-scatter converge). The base owns the word-level split, the always-opaque words (zero layout shift), the transform+color assembly, the farther=lighter+larger ramp, the ONE air ease and the reduced-motion/narrow static fallback. This variant's engine (variant.js) ADDS a measured READING-ORDER cascade (computed from each word's RESTING x/y after layout) and an OUTWARD-from-centre scatter bias, on a LIGHT field with NO paired render. Byte-faithful to tx1-converge-faithful.html.

engine.model: converge-faithful — gray words scattered wide on BOTH axes (outward-biased from the measured paragraph centre) converge home on ONE air ease, gray->ink, sequenced by a measured reading-order cascade
engine.scatterReach: maxX = stageWidth*0.46, maxY = stageHeight*0.40 (WIDE diagonal, both axes)
engine.outwardBias: bias = centreCalm(0.18) + (1-centreCalm)*outFrac;  dx = (rndX*0.42 + ox*0.58)*maxX*bias  (centre words barely move + seat first, edge words fly far + seat last)
engine.distanceRamp: dist = hypot(dx/maxX, dy/maxY)/SQRT2;  scale = 1+(scaleFar-1)*dist;  rotation/skew scale with dist;  color = lerp ghost-near #b7b4ab -> ghost-far #d6d4cc by dist
engine.readingCascade: measure each word's resting x/y AFTER fonts.ready; sort by row (ry, bucket 14px) then column (rx); cascade position at = (orderIndex/(N-1))*cascade(0.40)
engine.companion: OPTIONAL quiet render (lower-right) eases in only AFTER the statement seats (at cascade + duration*0.7); graceful-optional — hides on image error

skin.field: LIGHT — pale calm paper (radial #f3f1ea -> #eceae3) with a faint quiet structure grid
skin.render: none paired — only an optional quiet companion whisper lower-right
skin.fallback: reduced-motion / narrow (<=720px) => static readable paragraph, companion static below, no scatter / pin / scrub
